name: academic-writer
description: AI-first academic writing assistant for Humanities researchers. Produces rigorously cited, style-matched academic articles as .docx files.

google_api_key.title: Gemini API key
google_api_key.description: Google AI Studio API key for the bundled `aw` CLI (drafting, editing, synthesis, OCR). Free tier at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Stored securely (OS keychain / protected credentials file), never in plaintext settings.json. Bridged to the `aw` binary via the plugin's SessionStart hook (exported as GOOGLE_API_KEY). Optional — use the GOOGLE_API_KEY environment variable directly if you skip this.

jev_api_key.title: Jev (TypeSafe) API key
jev_api_key.description: Optional. Enables Jev shadow/cascade judgments at plugin decision points. Stored securely (OS keychain), never in plaintext settings.
